lcc_original: 上帝就創造大魚、和滋生在水中各樣能行動的活物，各從其類；又創造各樣有翅膀的鳥兒，各從其類：上帝看這很好。
notes: WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר, relative particle) attached to 在: LCC restructures UNV's relative clause 水中所 into locative 在水中; 在 is the closest functional equivalent for the relativizer
Rule 3 applied: UNV implicit {<WAH03588>} (כִּי = that) is rendered as explicit 這 in LCC — braces dropped, tag attached directly as 這<WAH03588>
LCC 很好 vs UNV 是好的: 很 (intensifier) has no Hebrew root; H2896 (טוֹב = good) attached after 很好 as the trailing phrase tag
LCC 有翅膀的鳥兒 expands UNV 飛鳥: H3671 (כָּנָף = wing) → attached after 有翅膀; H5775 (עוֹף = bird) → attached after 鳥兒
Second 又創造 carries no SN: Hebrew has only one verb בָּרָא; the repeated Chinese verb is a translation addition with no Hebrew counterpart
